before.title: BPI development and distribution cooperation
before.description: BPI and Adam implement operational cooperation under the consolidated BPI agreement: independent BPI management, brand, application ownership, licences and specialist support; AION engineering assistance and Logix distribution/training. This cooperation implements the accepted $150,000 investment agreement for Adam’s 33% fully diluted interest, including AION’s C/TUI redevelopment work and future-platform cooperation. Date selected for the alternative scenario.

after.title: BPI development and distribution cooperation
after.description: BPI and Adam implement operational cooperation under the consolidated BPI agreement: independent BPI management, brand, application ownership, licences and specialist support; AION engineering assistance and Logix distribution/training. This cooperation implements the accepted $150,000 investment agreement for Adam’s 33% fully diluted interest, including AION’s C/TUI redevelopment work and future-platform cooperation. Date selected for the alternative scenario. The cooperation also provides for later launch qualification, BPI-authorised Academy training and direct sales, with BPI retaining its software, independent licensing and specialist support.

inputs.description: BPI's accepted 15 February investment and C/TUI redevelopment agreement establishes the obligations implemented by this operational cooperation.

outcomes.description: The partners establish arrangements for qualifying independently licensed BPI applications and supporting their launch, dealer preparation and BPI-authorised Logix Computer Academy courses. BPI retains application ownership, licences and specialist support.

The cooperation supports a later programme of BPI-authorised courses and direct sales starting on 17 July 1978, after the NCC premiere. This start is separate from the Academy's March establishment and June 5 five-city public announcement.
